$comment: NEW-52 exponentialTalk spike numbers. Synthetic clips: the 20 phrases of data/phrases.json spoken by Kokoro (en) and Qwen3-TTS 1.7B (de + en); no human recordings yet (scripts/record.sh). WER is scored against the spoken form; identifiers like 'E X P twelve forty two' count word by word, which penalises engines that normalise them to 'exp1242'.
machine: macbook (Apple M4 Pro, 10P+4E cores, 24 GB, macOS 27.0)

tts.engine: kokoro v1.0 (sherpa-onnx 2.0, lexicon, no espeak-ng), CPU 4 threads

os_voice_macos_say.engine: macOS `say` (AVSpeechSynthesizer), voices Anna de_DE + Samantha en_US, the compact voices installed by default (no Enhanced/Premium voice downloaded), --data-format=LEI16@16000 -o <wav>
os_voice_macos_say.note: wall = request → whole clip on disk (say -o does not stream); the very first Anna call took 4.0 s (voice load), every later call ~1.0-1.1 s for Anna and ~0.75-0.98 s for Samantha regardless of length, so the per-call floor is ~0.75 s of process+engine start, not synthesis. RSS is the say client only: synthesis runs in the system speech daemon.
os_voice_macos_say.quality: not judged by ear in this session (the agent cannot listen; clips are in out/os-voice-mac for Danny: `afplay out/os-voice-mac/de-01.wav`). Proxy: Whistle hears Anna's German at 45.7 % WER against 27.2 % for Qwen3-TTS's German, and the Zipformer hears Samantha at 24.1 % against 13.8 % for Kokoro, so both compact voices are harder for the recognisers than the neural engines; Anna is the 2000s concatenative voice.

qwen3_tts_1_7b_q4km_llama_cpp_metal.engine: Qwen3-TTS-12Hz-1.7B-Base Q4_K_M + mmproj Q8_0 (ggml-org), llama-tts b11846 macOS arm64, Metal on Apple M4 Pro

cpu_only_de_01.note: the vocoder is the CPU cost (3.0 s vs 0.67 s on Metal); slower than real time, as on mint's CPU

qwen3_tts_1_7b_q4km_llama_cpp_metal.note: not streaming: total = prompt eval + generation + vocoder for the whole utterance; process wall adds ~0.8-1.0 s of model load per call (a resident worker pays it once; the first call paid 2.3 s more). RSS 6.9 GB is unified memory (Metal maps the weights into the process). German: all 10 de clips generated; quality not judged by ear here.

vad_knob.min_silence_0_5_s: end-of-utterance lag 500 ms on every clip (Kokoro and say sets)

manual.kws_exponential: EXPONENTIAL / HEY_EXPONENTIAL / EXPO never fired on the Kokoro set, plain or boosted 2.5x at threshold 0.05 (same as mint); HEY fired on en-01 at 700 ms; on the say set STOP fired on en-01 at 1600 ms and HEY did not
not_measured: Nemotron 3.5 (transcribe.cpp has no macOS Metal build in the time box; CUDA-only on mint)
channels (CoreAudio per-app capture needs a tap, not tried)
